description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2014 World Championships, a Team Plasma deck: Thundurus-EX and Colress Machine attach lots of Energy early, the ACE SPEC Scramble Switch brings in a powered-up Pokémon for surprise Knock Outs, and Deoxys-EX on the Bench adds damage to the main attacker, Kyurem. The 2014 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., from 15 to 17 August 2014.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2014 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
